products.name: Pharmacy ERP
products.tagline: Medicines, batches, expiry and the counter.
products.description: For retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers: medicine catalogue, batch and expiry tracking, purchasing and receiving, dispensing and sales at the counter, and prescriptions. Finance & Accounting can be added for the books.

products.name: Retail & Trading ERP
products.tagline: Retail and wholesale trading, from the counter to the invoice.
products.description: For retail stores, supermarkets, wholesalers and trading companies: point of sale, quotations, orders, invoices, delivery notes, purchasing and stock. Finance & Accounting can be added for the books.

products.name: Restaurant ERP
products.tagline: Tables, orders and the kitchen, with bills and tills.
products.description: For restaurants, cafés, bars and hotel kitchens: the menu, table orders, kitchen tickets, bills and tills, and drinks stock. Finance & Accounting can be added for the books.

products.name: Education ERP
products.tagline: Admissions to results, with student fees.
products.description: For schools, colleges and universities: admissions, classes, attendance, examinations, student fees and staff. Finance & Accounting can be added for the books.

products.name: NGO ERP
products.description: For NGOs and development organizations: programs and projects, donors and grants, budgets, expenses, procurement and staff. Finance & Accounting can be added for fund accounting.

products.name: Finance & Accounting
products.tagline: Advanced accounting, on its own or with any Miles ERP.
products.description: Chart of accounts, journals, receivables, payables, banking and financial statements: the Finance application any Miles ERP can post to when it is added.
